select a.scd_start_date,b.SCD_END_DATE,case when c.previous_business_day is null then b.SCD_END_DATE else c.previous_business_day end ,a.* from D360.DEP_TDMASTER_20240628_PATCH a
inner join (
            select ACID,BANK_ID,SCD_START_DATE,
            LEAD(SCD_START_DATE, 1 ,'9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY ACID ,BANK_ID  ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) as SCD_END_DATE
            from D360.DEP_TDMASTER_20240628_PATCH where ACID IN (
                 'PA1024209'
                ,'PA1031745'
                ,'PA1030022'
                ,'PA1030000'
                ,'PA1024226'
            ) ) b
            on a.acid = b.acid and a.SCD_START_DATE = b.SCD_START_DATE and a.bank_id = b.BANK_ID
left join eds.date_dim c on b.scd_end_date = c.fulldate
ORDER BY acid, 1,2





WITH AR_REG AS
(
                SELECT SOLIDSET.SOL_ID,SOLIDSET.BANK_ID, MAX(AREA.SET_DESC) AREA, MAX(REGION.SET_DESC) REGION FROM EDS.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE SOLIDSET  
                LEFT JOIN EDS.vw_AREA_DIM AREA
                        ON SOLIDSET.SET_ID = AREA.SET_ID
                        AND SOLIDSET.BANK_ID = AREA.BANK_ID
                        AND @Datetoprocess BETWEEN AREA.SCD_Start_date and AREA.SCD_End_date
                LEFT JOIN EDS.vw_REGION_DIM REGION
                        ON SOLIDSET.SET_ID = REGION.SET_ID
                        AND SOLIDSET.BANK_ID = REGION.BANK_ID
                        AND @Datetoprocess BETWEEN REGION.SCD_Start_date and REGION.SCD_End_date
                WHERE SOLIDSET.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND SOLIDSET.DEL_FLG <> 'Y' AND (LEFT(SOLIDSET.SET_ID,2) = 'AR' OR LEFT(SOLIDSET.SET_ID,3) = 'REG')
                GROUP BY SOLIDSET.SOL_ID,SOLIDSET.BANK_ID
                )

CREATE TABLE EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(CUST_ID)
)
AS
SELECT BANK_ID
	, BAY_USER_ID
	, BRANCH_ID
	, CORP_USER
	, CUST_BANK_ID
	, CUST_ID
	, CUSTOMER_TYPE
	, DB_TS
	, DEL_FLG
	, GRP_ID
	, R_CRE_ID
	, R_CRE_TIME
	, R_MOD_ID
	, R_MOD_TIME
	, Cast(START_DATE AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm
FROM 
(
	SELECT BANK_ID
		, BAY_USER_ID
		, BRANCH_ID
		, CORP_USER
		, CUST_BANK_ID
		, CUST_ID
		, CUSTOMER_TYPE
		, DB_TS
		, DEL_FLG
		, GRP_ID
		, R_CRE_ID
		, R_CRE_TIME
		, R_MOD_ID
		, R_MOD_TIME
		, isActive
--		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm
		, Row_Number() Over (PARTITION BY BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID, CORP_USER, CUST_ID 
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) SEQ_NUMBER
		, Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID, CORP_USER, CUST_ID 
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  
	FROM BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;
